paper.title: Evolution of indirect reciprocity by image scoring

headline: Nowak-Sigmund 1998 image scoring (agent-based): 1/3 locked clauses REPRO; P2 information threshold q>c/b REPRO (collapse<1% acts for q<=0.05, sustained 1.00 at q=1); P1 and P3 honest MISSes — the faithful mutation-free model drifts among cooperative strategies (k<=0) instead of fixing on exactly k=0, and under m=10n the group-size decay of cooperation does not appear

verdicts.gate: P1 no-mutation full-info fixation to stern discriminator k=0 (freq_k0>0.95, |mean k|<0.5, k=0 modal in >=90% of seeds)
reasons: k=0 frequency = 0.2000 (need > 0.95); |mean k| = 2.4000 (need < 0.5); k=0 modal in 20% of 20 seeds (need >= 90%). Cooperation IS established (coop-act fraction = 1.000) but the population drifts among cooperative strategies (k<=0) rather than fixing on exactly k=0 — the known neutral drift of plain image scoring without mutation (all k<=0 strategies are payoff-equivalent once images saturate).

verdicts.gate: P2 information threshold q>c/b sustains cooperation (collapse <1% acts for q<=0.05; coop-strategy>0.6 at q=1.0; crossover near q~c/b=0.1)
P3 group-size effect (with mutation): coop-strategy fraction decreases monotonically with n (~0.90/0.47/0.18 at n=20/50/100)
reasons: coop-strategy fraction by n: n=20:0.887(target 0.9+/-0.1), n=50:0.999(target 0.47+/-0.12), n=100:0.999(target 0.18+/-0.1); monotone decreasing = False; all in target band = False. Under the locked m=10n interactions/generation the per-capita information an individual's image is built from is CONSTANT in n (each agent is a donor ~10 times regardless of n), so cooperation does not decay with group size in this faithful formulation — the published decrease requires a fixed total round count so larger groups dilute reputation, which m=10n does not impose.

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + locked-prediction discipline reproduce the indirect-reciprocity information threshold and would honestly report the plain-image-scoring drift + group-size null as MISSes rather than tune them

citations: Nowak, M.A. & Sigmund, K. (1998). Evolution of indirect reciprocity by image scoring. Nature 393:573-577. doi:10.1038/31225.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the cooperative-act fraction, cooperative-strategy fraction, and the k=0 stern-discriminator frequency
